qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Sole-source classified defense electronics, certified tactical radio installed base (Falcon IV, SINCGARS), and domestic duopoly in solid rocket motors (Aerojet Rocketdyne) create insurmountable switching barriers. While 5-year GAAP ROIC (5-7%) is depressed by heavy merger goodwill, underlying tangible operating ROIC exceeds 20% on hard capital.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Balance Sheet). Long-term debt of ~$11.1B against net income of ~$1.5B results in LT Debt / NI of ~7.2x (substantially exceeding the <=4.0x ceiling), while EBIT/interest coverage of ~4.1x falls short of the >5.0x fortress threshold following debt-funded acquisitions of Aerojet Rocketdyne and Link 16. Tangible equity remains negative.
qualitative.evidence: L3Harris operates across four core defense segments: Communication Systems, Integrated Mission Systems, Space & Airborne Systems, and Aerojet Rocketdyne. Free cash flow conversion is strong ($2.68B FCF in FY25 vs ~$1.5B net income), supported by LHX NeXt operational efficiencies. However, the balance sheet was substantially leveraged to fund the $4.7B cash acquisition of Aerojet Rocketdyne in 2023, expanding total debt to over $11B against $19.3B equity and $20.3B goodwill (resulting in negative tangible net worth). With interest expense at ~$550M-$600M and EBIT at ~$2.3B-$2.5B, interest coverage is ~4.1x (below the 5.0x minimum requirement), failing Gate 6.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
